name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_acute_appendicitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute appendicitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute appendicitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of acute appendicitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of acute appendicitis.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_undergone_appendectomy_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone an appendectomy at any time in their history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone an appendectomy at any time in their history, regardless of when the procedure was performed.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone an appendectomy at any time in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone an appendectomy.

name: patient_has_undergone_appendectomy_inthehistory@@occurred_in_16_march_to_30_may_2018_or_2019_or_2020
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's appendectomy occurred within 16 March to 30 May in 2018, 2019, or 2020.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's appendectomy occurred within 16 March to 30 May in 2018, 2019, or 2020.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's appendectomy did not occur within any of these periods.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the appendectomy occurred within these periods.

name: patient_has_finding_of_acute_appendicitis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has acute appendicitis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has the clinical finding of acute appendicitis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have the clinical finding of acute appendicitis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has the clinical finding of acute appendicitis.

name: appendectomy_performed_date_value_recorded_in_history_withunit_date
meaning: Date value indicating the date on which the patient underwent an appendectomy, if any, recorded in the patient's history. The unit is date (YYYY-MM-DD).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether or when the patient underwent an appendectomy.
when_value: Set to the date (in YYYY-MM-DD format) on which the patient underwent an appendectomy, if such a procedure is recorded in the patient's history.
